{{Top|leg}}
The '''Clan Tarkona''' was one of the numerous clans of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], the native inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. In [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] [[Language/Legends|language]], the name ''tarkona'' meant "stormy weather." One of the clan's most well-known members was [[Nolaa Tarkona]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Twi'lek who preached [[Anti-Humanism|anti-Humanist]] theories in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].
